Method of Attack: Encrypts VMware ESXi server virtual machine files by shutting down running VMs and encrypting files with .log, .vmdk, .vmem, .vswp, and .vmsn extensions
Renames files before encryption, causing encryption failure if rename permission is denied
Uses public/private key encryption with SOSEMANUK stream cipher
Creates ransom notes in each folder with instructions and Tor negotiation site links
Performs data exfiltration and uses double-extortion by threatening to leak or sell stolen data
Indicators of Compromise: Ransom notes named 'How To Restore Your Files.txt' in encrypted folders
Unique Tor negotiation sites per victim
